'''Brandon Knapp Hunt Down and Duel the Jedi v1 0''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Brandon Knapp]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-5333">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/5333 Hunt Down and Duel the Jedi v1 0], DeckTech (Brandon "Tantive XXX" Knapp, 11 April 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/5333/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/5333/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018183424/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/5333/ Wayback Machine].</ref>
